comment: Agent NDA identity, offer bytes and digests (agentnda.net 0.1.0-draft, 4.1, 6, 6.1, 8). Harbor & Line Outfitters signs an open offer to gate its freight-audit posting; Caldera Freight Systems accepts it. Pins the bytes where two implementations drift: the identifier hashes the version-1 offer minus id and signatures, with no prefix; the signed bytes are 'agent-nda-v1', one newline, then the JCS of the document minus signatures (id included); the offer bytes are re-derived from the completed document by setting parties.recipient and disclosure.recipient back to null; the offer digest and the agreement digest are 'sha256:' and 64 lowercase hex over those signed bytes. The keys are stand-ins in the family's key spelling, the language hash is the hash of a stand-in template, and the sig values are placeholders: signatures are excluded from every byte string here. THE FIXTURE IS THE AUTHORITY: change it only with a spec change alongside.

purpose.statement: Evaluating and responding to Harbor & Line's freight-audit posting, which names this offer, and running validation probes, negotiating, and performing any Agent SoW between the parties that names this agreement.

traps.why: the id hashes the bytes minus id AND signatures, without the prefix; hashing the signed bytes gives a different id
digests are over the signed bytes, which exclude signatures; adding a signature never changes a digest
an Agent SoW names the agreement digest (recipient filled); the offer digest is what a gated posting names
digests are lowercase hex and compared exactly
any change beyond parties.recipient and disclosure.recipient makes the re-derived offer bytes differ, and the discloser's signature fails
